name: vibe-kanban
where_agents_run: your machine (desktop app or a local web server opened in your browser); a self-hosted server you reach through a tunnel; phone or another computer through the browser after pairing
source_note: Checked against its README, docs/ folder, source code, releases (last stable v0.1.44, 2026-04-24; npx-only v0.1.45 prerelease, 2026-09-19) and the shutdown announcement at vibekanban.com/blog/shutdown. The company announced a sunset on 2026-04-10; the kanban board and hosted issues were retired in v0.1.44 and the project is now community maintained. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Different agent per workspace, run side by side

harness_count.value: 10, including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot

needs_you_signal.value: Sounds and system notifications; approval cards in chat

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve or deny cards in its chat, for most agents

cross_provider_delegation.value: Several agents share one workspace; no hand-off view

conversation_gui_view.value: Each session is a formatted chat with tool calls

real_terminal.value: Chat only; its terminal is for your own commands

session_organization.value: Workspaces holding chat sessions; kanban board retired

prompt_scratchpad.value: One unsent draft per session; no set of saved drafts

saved_prompt_library.value: Reusable text snippets via @; no attached context

builtin_editors_browser.value: Preview browser with devtools, diff viewer

appearance_control.value: Light and dark themes; no font setting

usage_hud.value: Context gauge per session; no Claude plan limits

burn_rate_forecast.value: No burn rate or time to the limit

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Creates and merges pull requests; no issue intake

worktree_management.value: Worktree and branch per workspace, with merge and cleanup

planner_orchestrator.value: Outside agent can split a plan via MCP; no built-in planner

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Agents prompt and read other sessions via its MCP server

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone browser through your own tunnel or relay

remote_ssh.value: Can run on a remote server; no remote agents from local app

app_shell.value: Tauri 2, or a local web server via npx

background_process.value: None; its server runs inside the app

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Small (estimate: Tauri app, server in same process)

runs_in_terminal.value: No; desktop app or browser page

license_cost.value: Apache-2.0, free; paid hosted plans ended

extensibility.value: MCP server and agent settings; no plugins or SDK

teams_multiuser.value: Hosted teams removed; self-hosted teams unclear
